summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for ChromeAmp (iPod-style click wheel music player). Backend: 3/3 pytest cases passed (GET /api/ Hello World, GET/POST /api/status with persistence verification). Frontend: All 4 tabs render on Expo web preview, click wheel buttons fire correct actions, SELECT toggles VOL/TRACK mode, MENU navigates to Folders, Play/Prev/Next do not crash with empty queue. Folders shows Permission required card + Grant Access (no crash on web). Equalizer renders FrequencyGraph, preamp slider, 6 preset chips, bands list with type/enable/delete + Freq/Gain/Q sliders; Bass Boost preset applies, Add/Remove band work, filter type picker expands and updates, Reset works, Export does not crash on web. Settings shows all 4 rows; Shuffle + Repeat + Rescan + Permissions are tappable. All 25+ required testIDs are present and correctly mapped. Console warnings present but non-blocking (deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props from RN core, not user code).

issues: Bottom tab labels (Player/Folders/Equalizer/Settings) are slightly clipped/overlapped by the click-wheel bottom in 390x844 mobile viewport — visible in screenshot; consider increasing wheelWrap bottom margin or reducing wheel size on short screens

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' fired by GlassCard/ClickWheel shadow styles. Native still requires shadowColor/shadowOffset/etc so this is a web-only warning. Optional: gate web with Platform.select or accept the warning. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/ClickWheel.tsx:186-190, /app/frontend/src/components/GlassCard.tsx (shadow* in styles)

Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from LinearGradient/BlurView with pointerEvents prop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:?? (LinearGradient overlay) and /app/frontend/src/components/ClickWheel.tsx:107,114

Equalizer screen imports 'expo-file-system/legacy'. Works but legacy submodule is officially marked for removal in a future SDK. Migrate to the new File API (new in expo-file-system v19) when convenient. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/equalizer.tsx:6

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow on web (or Platform.select) to silence RN Web warnings.
(Optional) Move pointerEvents from props to style on LinearGradient/inner overlays.
(Optional) Plan migration from expo-file-system/legacy to the new File API in equalizer.tsx before next Expo SDK upgrade.
(Optional UI) Verify bottom tab labels are not clipped behind the click wheel on small viewports (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: status_checks insert stores Pydantic dict directly; works but '_id' from Mongo is correctly avoided because response_model=StatusCheck filters it. No issue.
server.py: datetime.utcnow is deprecated in Python 3.12+. Consider datetime.now(timezone.utc).
PlayerContext: empty queue + togglePlay/prev/next are safely no-op (verified via UI taps with no crash).
ClickWheel: hitSlop on Pressables is good for touch targets; MENU/Prev/Next/Play visual touch areas (~36x16) are below 44pt but hitSlop=10 brings effective tap area up. Acceptable.
Equalizer: handleExport gracefully degrades on web (Sharing not available -> showToast). Good fallback.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_chromeamp StatusCheck via POST /api/status during persistence test (single test row, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Native-only features (expo-media-library scanning, expo-audio playback, expo-document-picker, Haptics) are intentionally non-functional on web; UI gracefully falls back. Real audio + folder scan must be validated post-APK build by the user. All required testIDs verified present.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All flows pass.
